kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio create-deployment --workspace-id 47800 --accessibility PRIVATE --resource-type Flow --resource-id flow-asdf000000123 --resource-snapshot-id snap-asfg000000123 --service-name myservice01 --description This_is_description --enable-trace true --chat-history-config ConnectionName=rdsconnection StorageType=RDS --work-dir oss://mybucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/workdir/ --content-moderation-config EnableInputModeration=true EnableOutputModeration=true StreamingModerationThreshold=5 --deployment-config metadata_:_name_:_langstudio_20260000003848_jro7_,_instance_:1,_workspace_id_:_285000_,_enable_webservice_:false_,_cloud_:_computing_:_instances_:_type_:_ecs.g7.xlarge_,_networking_:_vpc_id_:_vpc-bp1obprt0000004bzo00d_,_vswitch_id_:_vsw-bp1p6i36k000000pmfhw8_,_security_group_id_:_sg-bp1djud4000000zecl5a --auto-approval true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeployment

parameters.help_en:
Workspace visibility. Valid values:  
PRIVATE: The service is visible only to you and administrators within this workspace.  
PUBLIC: The service is visible to all users within this workspace.
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether to automatically skip the deployment confirmation step.
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动跳过部署确认环节
parameters.name: auto_approval

fields.help_en: Connection name. This parameter is required when the chat history storage type is RDS.
fields.help_zh: 连接名称。对话历史存储方式为RDS的时候需要指定该参数
fields.name: connection_name

fields.help_en:
Storage class. Valid values:  
LOCAL: Chat history is stored in a local SQLite file. This option does not support multi-instance deployment.  
OSS: Chat history is stored under a specific path within the service's OSS workspace path.  
RDS: Chat history is stored in an RDS table, and an RDS connection must be specified.
fields.help_zh:
存储方式。取值：
LOCAL: 对话历史保存在本地SQLite文件，不支持多实例的部署方式。
OSS：对话历史保存在服务OSS工作路径下特定的路径下。
RDS：对话历史保存在RDS的表中，需要指定一个RDS连接
fields.name: storage_type

fields.help_en: Whether to enable security review for input
fields.help_zh: 是否启用对输入的安全审查
fields.name: enable_input_moderation

fields.help_en: Whether to enable content moderation for output
fields.help_zh: 是否启用对输出的内容审查
fields.name: enable_output_moderation

fields.help_en: The cache size for streaming output content submitted for moderation. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小，默认为5
fields.name: streaming_moderation_threshold

parameters.help_en: Deployment configuration. For details, see Deployment Configuration (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services) in PAI-EAS
parameters.help_zh: 部署配置。具体参考PAI-EAS的部署配置 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services)
parameters.name: deployment_config

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether to enable Tracing Analysis.
parameters.name: enable_trace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource to deploy
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID of the resource to deploy. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys directly based on this snapshot. If this parameter is not provided, the system creates a new snapshot of the resource and then executes the deployment
parameters.help_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署
parameters.name: resource_snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type to deploy. Valid values:
Flow: A pipeline project
Code: A code project
parameters.help_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Service name. Format requirements:
Supports lowercase letters, digits, and underscores
Must start with a letter
Length must be 1 to 45 characters
parameters.help_zh:
服务名字。格式要求：
支持小写字母、数字和下划线
必须以字母开头
长度1-45个字符
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The OSS working directory for the service. It is used to store the service's runtime logs, conversation history, and other data
parameters.help_zh: 服务的OSS工作目录。用于存储服务的运行日志、对话历史等
parameters.name: work_dir

parameters.help_en: Workspace ID. For information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
